title: AI Agents Placed Only Hundreds of DoorDash Orders
description: On its Q3 2026 earnings call, DoorDash CEO Tony Xu said third-party AI agents have placed only several hundred orders, against roughly three million deliveries a day on average per its 2025 report. Most users still order through DoorDash's own app.

beats.vo: DoorDash gets three million orders a day. AI agents? Several hundred.

beats.text: Versus several hundred from AI agents
beats.vo: DoorDash's CEO said this on its latest earnings call. Most people still use the app itself. But here's the part nobody tells you: DoorDash is still building agent tools of its own, so this is early days, not a verdict.
Would you let an AI agent order your dinner? Comment yes or no, and tell us why.
